quotes: The maximum size for a letter is 15 inches long, 12 inches high, and 3/4 inch thick.
Letter-size mail must be no more than 6-1/8 inches high by 11-1/2 inches long and no thicker than 1/4 inch to qualify for machinable letter pricing.
Letters that are nonmachinable are subject to a nonmachinable surcharge of $0.49.
First-Class Mail International letters may not exceed 6-1/8 inches high by 11-1/2 inches long.
Large envelopes (flats) weighing more than 15.994 ounces are charged the parcel rate.

A letter is nonmachinable if it has an aspect ratio (length divided by height) outside the range of 1.3 to 2.5, does not bend easily, has clasps or similar closure devices, or contains items that cause the thickness to be uneven.
